meta.name: yaml-master
meta.description:
Execute proactive YAML intelligence: automatically activates when working with YAML files.
Use when appropriate context detected. Trigger with relevant phrases based on skill purpose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你解析、校验和转换 YAML 配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要读写 YAML 配置文件
copy.tagline_en: Parse, validate, and convert YAML configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often read or write YAML configuration files

howto.what: 处理YAML文件时，Claude会检查语法错误、调整缩进和引号、按目标系统核对字段结构，找出重复键等问题，给出改动最小的修正和后续检查命令。
howto.when: 当你处理 .yml 或 .yaml 文件（如 Kubernetes、GitHub Actions、Docker Compose 配置），或要求检查/修正 YAML 时。

say.text: 这个GitHub Actions工作流缩进有问题，帮我修一下。
say.note: 会定位错误并给出最小修正。

say.text: 把这段JSON转成YAML，注意引号处理。
say.note: 会加必要引号避免类型问题。

say.text: 帮我检查这个Kubernetes配置是否符合schema。
say.note: 会核对字段结构并列出问题。

howto.what_en: When working with YAML files, Claude validates syntax, normalizes formatting (indentation, quoting), checks structure against the target system (e.g., Kubernetes, GitHub Actions), flags risky patterns like duplicate keys, and outputs a minimal patch plus a validation checklist.
howto.when_en: Activates automatically when working with .yml/.yaml files (e.g., Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Docker Compose) or when asked to inspect/fix YAML.

say_en.text: Fix the indentation in this GitHub Actions workflow.
say_en.note: Locates the error and suggests minimal fixes.

say_en.text: Convert this JSON to YAML with safe quoting.
say_en.note: Adds explicit quoting to avoid type surprises.

say_en.text: Check this Kubernetes config against its schema.
say_en.note: Validates structure and lists any issues.
